what: Two thin (2px) sine curves run through the vertical center of the panel and undulate at different speeds (one wave per width, amplitude 80·70px, phase .35·.22 per second). The line color comes from a horizontal four-stripe gradient of two colors, pink↔sky blue, that shifts 10·7px every frame so the color travels along the lines. Whole canvas opacity .3. At phone width (769 or less): amplitude 40·30, speed .44·.19, flow 5·3. Amplitude scales with the reference width (1440·414). Fixed behind the screen, the waves flow behind the photo slider.

options.amp: Amplitude per row (px, at base width) comma-separated, default 80,70
options.speed: Per-row phase speed (half of radians per second), default 0.35,0.22
options.flow: px the gradient flows per frame on each row, default 10,7

note: The original keeps rAF running — the part draws only while the panel is visible. With reduced motion, a single still curve

from.where: shared.js .in-wave (two fixed wave lines behind the screen — original .bl_waveLine, two canvas.js_wave, pink #fe9989 · sky #a6cdda, opacity .3)
